origin.description: Build a condition that describes one progress event.
origin.usage: progression(message = character(0L), amount = 1, step = NULL, time = progression_time, ..., type = "update", class = NULL, progressor_uuid = NULL, progression_index = NULL, progression_time = Sys.time(), call = NULL, calls = sys.calls(), owner_session_uuid = NULL)

arguments.name: message
arguments.text: Character pieces pasted with an empty separator, or a function called with the condition.

arguments.name: amount
arguments.text: Numeric amount of progress. Stored as numeric.

arguments.name: step
arguments.text: Completed step. When set, a handler later treats amount as this step minus the current step.

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: Kind of progression, such as update, initiate, or finish.

arguments.name: class
arguments.text: Extra class names placed before progression, immediateCondition, and condition.

origin.details: The object stores owner_session_uuid, progressor_uuid, session_uuid, progression_index, progression_time, type, message, amount, step, time, any extra named fields, call, and calls. A datetime progression_time is formatted as %F %H:%M:%OS3 %z. Extra names must be unique and non-empty. Signaling walks calling handlers. A muffleProgression restart stops the walk. An unhandled progression does not raise.
origin.value: A condition of classes progression, immediateCondition, and condition.
origin.example:
p <- progression(message = "hello", amount = 2, type = "update")
cat(conditionMessage(p), "\n", sep = "")
cat(p$type, "\n", sep = "")
cat(p$amount, "\n", sep = "")
cat(paste(class(p), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Build a condition object that describes one progress event.
translation.usage: progression(message=(), amount=1.0, step=None, time=None, type="update", class_=None, progressor_uuid=None, progression_index=None, progression_time=None, call=None, calls=None, owner_session_uuid=None, **extra)

arguments.name: message
arguments.text: A string, a sequence of strings pasted with an empty separator, or a callable invoked with the condition. An empty sequence stays empty.

arguments.name: step
arguments.text: Completed step, stored as the caller passed it.

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: Kind of progression, such as update, initiate, or finish.

arguments.name: class_
arguments.text: R's class argument. Extra class names are placed before progression, immediateCondition, and condition.

translation.details: class is a Python keyword, so the argument is class_. progression_time is formatted with three fractional digits and a numeric offset when it is a datetime. Session identifiers will not equal R: they include time, pid, and a random draw, hashed with digest.digest. signal_condition walks a contextvar stack of calling handlers. A muffleProgression restart stops the walk. An unhandled progression does not raise.
translation.value: A Condition whose classes are progression, immediateCondition, and condition.
translation.example:
from progressr.condition import condition_message, progression
p = progression(message="hello", amount=2, type="update")
print(condition_message(p))
print(p["type"])
print(f"{p['amount']:g}")
print(" ".join(p.classes))
